d: Chayan Rastogi and Prashant Kapoor will discuss in this video whether Gautam Gambhir will give young sensation Vaibhav Suryavanshi a chance in the playing XI for the fifth T20 match between India and New Zealand! With the series reaching its final stage, all eyes are on Team India's possible changes and the opportunities waiting for its young players. Will Gambhir experiment with the playing XI or stick to his trusted combination? Does Vaibhav Suryavanshi deserve a place in the team, and could the youngster make an impact if he gets his chance? We’ll discuss the possible team selection,…
